messages.subject: Shiny app is working locally. What is wrong?
parts:
Hey everybody

im just getting into shiny, so I dont know if this is an obvious error but:

If have written a small shiny application that runs perfectly on my local pc but when I try to publish on my personal shinyapps.io account, the app loads but stops working (greyed out). The uploaded demo app works.

Here are the files:

http://cgross.shinyapps.io/debug (not working)
https://gist.github.com/caspargross/2520cb7172d6d331f7ce  (runs on my pc with the  runGist("2520cb7172d6d331f7ce" command)

thanks for having a look!
Caspar

messages.author: 3da48b33a2f506a9
messages.subject: Re: Shiny app is working locally. What is wrong?
parts:
Are you running on Windows?

The runGist() command didn't work for me. So I downloaded your code, and tried it; same error. The issue was a character in the server.R file:

d = −r

The "dash" (minus) character in this line doesn't seem to be a valid dash. I changed that and your app started working.

Fereshteh

messages.subject: Re: Shiny app is working locally. What is wrong?
parts:
I am saving it as UTF8 on my Mac, and see this problem. I have also deployed the app to shinyapps.io and to a local Shiny Server after saving it as UTF8, and still the same problem. But when I look at that character, it is a valid UTF8 character (e28892 which is minus sign). I will look into this further, but seems like you are fine with using the ascii (-) character.

Fereshteh
